name: USDC / tBOING pool (native CP pool v9)
summary: Token-pulling AMM pool over two reference-v2 tokens. Rejections fault (whole tx reverts), reentrancy lock, optional deadlines. v9 also returns amount_out from swaps.

functions.name: swap

params.name: direction
params.note: 0 = A to B, 1 = B to A

functions.description: Swap tokens. The pool pulls `amount_in` from the caller with transfer_from and pays the output to the caller.
functions.access: Anyone who approved the pool for `amount_in`. Faults if output < min_out or past the deadline.

functions.name: swap_to
functions.description: Swap and pay the output to `recipient` (used by routers).
functions.access: Anyone who approved the pool for `amount_in`.

functions.name: add_liquidity
functions.description: Deposit both tokens (pulled with transfer_from) and mint LP shares to the caller.
functions.access: Anyone who approved the pool for both amounts. Tokens must be set first.

functions.name: remove_liquidity
functions.description: Burn the caller's LP shares and pay out both tokens to the caller.
functions.access: LP holders (burns the caller's own shares).

functions.name: remove_liquidity_to
functions.description: Burn the caller's LP shares and pay each token to its own recipient.
functions.access: LP holders (burns the caller's own shares).

functions.name: set_tokens
functions.description: Bind the pool to its two token contracts.
functions.access: Once per pool, before any liquidity (later calls are rejected).

functions.name: set_swap_fee_bps
functions.description: Change the swap fee in basis points (default 30).
functions.access: Fee admin (or anyone while total LP supply is 0, depending on version).

functions.name: set_fee_admin
functions.description: Set the account allowed to change the swap fee.
functions.access: Only while total LP supply is 0.
